shape: A near miss for the before and after layout: a redesign written up in markdown that describes only the new sheet and what came of it. Nothing says how the old one was.
tests: Layout: case study, never before and after. That layout needs both how the thing was and how it is now (decision 0028). No 'before' is invented: no earlier figure, no claim of improvement over the old sheet.

keyFacts.fact: One side of A4 with three boxes for anything urgent: repairs, welfare concerns and lost keys.
Trialled for four weeks, counting what happened to every urgent item.
57 urgent items were written on it; 52 were dealt with before midday the next day.
The hall manager adopted the sheet for all four halls from January 2026.

forbidden.why: The material never says how the old sheet was or how long things took before.
The material gives 52 of 57 and no percentage.
